SELECT d.id, d.resource_id, d.active_generation, d.name, d.updated_at FROM resource r JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id AND d.resource_id = r.id JOIN file_object f ON f.enterprise_id = d.enterprise_id AND f.id = d.active_file_id WHERE
AND r.id IN #{id} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.active_generation > 0 AND f.status = 'ready' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND LOCATE(#{query}, d.name) > 0
AND (d.updated_at < #{cursor.time} OR (d.updated_at = #{cursor.time} AND d.id < #{cursor.id}))
ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
